channel.description: Latest articles from Inland Valley Daily Bulletin (dailybulletin.com)

item.title: High wind warning for 5 Freeway through Grapevine until Wednesday afternoon – gusts may reach 60 mph
item.description: On Tuesday at 5:52 p.m. a high wind warning was issued by the National Weather Service in effect until Wednesday Feb. 11, at 1 p.m. for 5 Freeway through Grapevine.

item.title: This week’s bestsellers at Southern California’s independent bookstores
item.description: See the top-selling hardcover and paperback fiction and nonfiction releases for the sales week that ended Feb. 8.

item.title: Time runs out for Riverside homeless project, but backers keep fighting
item.description: As the deadline for a second vote passes, supporters of turning the Quality Inn Motel into homeless housing again make their pleas.

item.title: High wind warning affecting 5 Freeway north of LA until early Wednesday morning – gusts could peak at 60 mph
item.description: 5 Freeway north of LA is under an updated high wind warning which was released by the National Weather Service on Tuesday at 9:27 p.m. The warning is in effect until Wednesday Feb. 11, at 4 a.m.

item.title: High wind warning issued for San Bernardino County Mountains and Apple/Lucerne Valleys until Wednesday afternoon
item.description: San Bernardino County Mountains and Apple/Lucerne Valleys are included in an updated high wind warning issued by the National Weather Service on Tuesday at 7:24 p.m. The warning is in effect until Wednesday Feb. 11, at 1 p.m.

item.title: Clippers can’t keep up with efficient Rockets in 4th
item.description: Kawhi Leonard scores 24 points for the visitors, but Houston shoots 50% from 3-point range and takes control in the fourth quarter before holding off the Clippers, 102-95. The teams meet again Wednesday night.

item.title: A person has been detained for questioning in the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie
item.description: Deputies detained the person during a traffic stop south of Tucson on Tuesday, according to the Pima County Sheriff’s Department.

item.title: Pastor of secretive religious group charged in murder of 4-year-old Colton boy says he now fears for his life
item.description: The attorney for Darryl Martin says the 'whole Crips gang' is considering killing his client; testimony continues on Timothy Thomas' untreated, fatal illness.

item.title: IE Varsity’s CIF Southern Section playoff scoreboard, Feb. 10
item.description: See how Inland teams fared in CIF Southern Section playoff events Tuesday, Feb. 10.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama scores season-high 40 as Spurs bury depleted Lakers
item.description: Wembanyama scores 37 during San Antonio’s 84-point first half as the visitors cruise to a 136-108 victory over a Lakers team playing without Luka Doncic, LeBron James and Austin Reaves among others.
